note: The nested tooltip page (TOOLTIP_TESTS, tools/build_tooltip_page.mjs) as one gallery case: its viewport, frames at 60 Hz and the inputs of the acceptance (hover a keyword, move into its tooltip, hover a keyword there, hold still until the first keyword pins at 3 s, drag the pinned window by its title, then hover an equipment keyword of an item card: its tooltip has a smoke of its own). Capture frames are multiples of 4: the original's smoke canvas draws on a 66 ms timer, which the reference clock runs every 4th frame, so the canvas then shows the frame's own time.
